text:
marie: heads-up — after the ATTNV2 kernel rollout + new quant profile we saw prefix cache hit rate drop for model-redwood-v2-small on seq=128. pre-rollout 87% -> now ~61%. median p50 latency up ~18% for short prompts.
eli: ugh, same rollout where we flipped the fused-attn variant + packed-quant flag right? any breakdown by kernel_variant in metrics?
sam: confirming logs from canary pool (region-us-east-1). warmup traces show fewer KV prefix matches, and eviction rate slightly higher. added heatmap to the dashboard.
marie: exact samples: before keys per-request normalized to 3 canonical segments, after rollout keys include an extra "kernel_variant" token in the key string for some backends. likely keying mismatch.
eli: that explains a lot — the compile step appends a runtime tag so the key bytes change even for identical prompts. hash(s) differ -> cache miss. looks like compile-time metadata leaked into key generation.
jen: can we patch key generation to canonicalize (strip runtime tags) while we roll back the kernel flag? quick fix would be to ignore kernel_variant when building prefix cache key.
marie: prototype patch attached in thread (small snippet):
```python
# old
key = f"{model}:{prompt_hash}:{kernel_variant}:{quant_profile}"
# new canonicalize approach
canonical_kernel = kernel_variant if include_kernel_in_key else "canonical"
key = f"{model}:{prompt_hash}:KVv1"
```
eli: agree — make key stable (KVv1). Also add metric prefix_cache.key_schema_version and log mismatches so future compiles don't silently change keys.
sam: plan: 1) quick patch to canonicalize key + deploy to canary (5%); 2) collect hit-rate for 30m; 3) if back to baseline, promote; 4) schedule full rollback of kernel flag if not.
jen: creating ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4921 — assigning to marie/eli.
marie: deploying patch to canary now. ops-bot: running deploy -> `deploy-bot start canary eng-runtime r=canary region=us-east-1`
deploy-bot: deploy started by marie — canary to 5% (us-east-1). CI: green, will monitor metrics.
ops-bot: added alert: prefix_cache.hit_rate_drop -> pager when drop >10% for 30m.
eli: small note — we should also validate quant profile ordering; some quant packs change tokenization-level padding which can change prompt_hash if we include padded bytes. better to hash normalized token ids only.
marie: agreed. follow-ups: a) canonical key v1 rollout, b) add key schema metric, c) integration test to assert kernel/quant flags don't change produced key for same prompt. I'll post results in 30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
sam: thanks. if canary recovers, we'll schedule the kernel variant re-rollout with safe-guard off by default. :thumbsup:
